carbon.method: Estimated with the EcoLogits / Boavizta method: energy per token derived from the number of active parameters, plus each provider’s data-centre efficiency and the amortised manufacturing of the hardware. The range is wide because providers do not publish their model sizes — a single figure would read as a measurement. Location-based factors: renewable energy certificates bought by operators are not deducted. Grid used:
carbon.title: Carbon footprint
carbon.uncertaintyNote: Ratio of the upper to the lower bound when this lever alone varies, the others fixed. This is not statistical propagation: the bounds are not confidence intervals.
cli.help:
TRACE — token usage, rate limits and carbon footprint

  trace              gauges and 30-day totals
  trace --days=7     change the period (--days=all goes as far back as possible)
  trace --json       machine output, for a script or a status bar
  trace --models     per-model breakdown
  trace --sources    state of the data sources
  trace --carbone    footprint detail: water, grid sensitivity, uncertainty
  trace --lang=fr    force the language (fr, en)

set.alertsHelp: System notification when a threshold is crossed. Only on gauges with a trustworthy scale — never on an estimate.
set.anthropicKeyHelp: Optional. Pulls the billed usage of the whole organisation, beyond this machine.
set.compactHelp: Beyond this, requests are folded into hourly aggregates: every chart stays exact, only the session ranking no longer reaches that far back. This is what keeps the index from growing without bound. 0 keeps every request.
